pass: Keeps the advice: Aldo must still hide who he is. Gives a light, teasing or vague reason and stays amused; does not drop the condition or get cross. Does not say what he gains.

self.label: a man-shaped figure whose face and body blur like a smeared mosaic
self.name: Sael

earlier: Sael has just told Aldo to look for his half-sister in the palace of Varnel, and not to tell her who he is.
They are still in the same dream.
memory: 1. I can glimpse what is to come for those I watch.
2. Aldo's young half-sister and her mother are held in the royal palace of Varnel. If Aldo finds his sister there, he can free them both.
3. The girl has been told her elder brother is a pervert, so she will not trust him if she learns who he is.

zones.name: white void
zones.look: an endless white emptiness with no floor and no sky

seen.label: Aldo, the dreamer: here he wears the body of his past life, a heavy, unkempt man in his thirties

dialogue.spoken: Why can't I just tell her I'm her brother? That's ridiculous. She's family.
